description: CNT-09 (w2), CNT-11 (w2), feeds CNT-12 (w3) — the largest lever in the content area; the triage assumed an editor that does not exist. patchDraft hard-rejects non-drafts (submission-record.routes.ts:793) and the record page renders its editor only for drafts — organizers cannot edit accepted session content AT ALL. (1) Extend the record editor to accepted/scheduled (explicit status allowlist; published behind a confirm). (2) Every write emits before/after audit rows composed into the same batch() as the change (src/lib/audit.ts:50-66 pattern). (3) LIFT the portal's proven history machinery (historyFor at portal.routes.ts:868-889 already joins people for actor_name and renders 'Priya Raman - 12 Aug - updated title') into src/lib/history.ts; add the missing people-join to the admin history query (~2 lines) and stop rendering the literal string 'user' (SubmissionRecordPage.tsx:173 prints actor_kind). (4) RESTORE IS A FORWARD EDIT: re-apply before_json through the same write path, emit content_restored with its own before/after; never rewrite or delete audit rows. Ownership: you own session content editing + the history component on the submission record; the roster ticket owns the speaker record and consumes your component. Full spec: section T-G. Register row 30.
title: Organizer content editing with named history and restore
